audit_scope: Worker-4 rechecked all packet-linked DBAASP A11 literature/assay/experiment rows against primary XML/PDF tables and merged sequence/literature rows.

cross_database_cautions.evidence_context: DBAASP sequence catalog stores WVKKVARKVVKIGRKVAR as a residue string; primary Table 2 reports A11 as C-terminally amidated, so the final curation preserves -NH2 explicitly.

Several DBAASP environmental-condition MIC rows carry the value and target but not the pH/temperature/salt condition; values are source-verified against Table 4 without inventing missing condition labels.
